title: Add TaskSpec worker assignment metadata
verifyCommands: bun test tests/policy.test.ts tests/task-from-template.test.ts tests/codex-dispatch.test.ts tests/run-log.test.ts tests/task-from-run.test.ts tests/batch-plan-draft.test.ts tests/batch-plan-assembly.test.ts tests/batch-plan-task-spec-preflight.test.ts tests/batch-plan-execution-batch-assembly.test.ts
instructions: Implement first-class worker assignment metadata on TaskSpec using the accepted decisions from references/initiatives/worker-assignment-guidance.md. That source brief is currently untracked in the main worktree, so treat these inlined decisions as authoritative for this task: add required TaskSpec fields taskFamily, workMode, and riskClass; candidate enum values are taskFamily: cli-command, core-module, docs-only, report-review, recovery; workMode: minimal-change, tdd-first, diagnosis-first; riskClass: routine, authority-sensitive, doctrine-sensitive, lifecycle-sensitive. Do not create a worker persona or roleplay roster. Assignment metadata is task-level guidance only and must not grant authority. Authority remains controlled by targetFiles, forbiddenChanges, verifyCommands, writerClass, and policy checks. Add task-template defaults so BK or a task author only edits them when wrong. Keep riskClass as a single value; do not add risk tags, risk notes, or compound risk metadata in this slice. Preserve metadata through template-created specs, failed-run recovery TaskSpecs, and BatchPlanDraft -> TaskSpecPlan -> TaskSpec preflight. Add deterministic worker prompt guidance that names the metadata and explicitly says it guides procedure but does not broaden target files, forbidden changes, verification, writerClass, commit, merge, cleanup, or lifecycle authority. Verify run logs preserve the embedded values; because WorkerRunLog embeds TaskSpec, this may only require focused test coverage unless code changes are needed. Keep BatchSpec authority and writer parallelism unchanged. Do not add automatic dispatch based on metadata. Do not migrate historical runs/**. Do not touch the two phase-55 initiative files listed in forbiddenChanges. Keep changes surgical and only in targetFiles. Start with focused tests, then implementation. Run every verify command before final response. Final response must include exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
